description: One row per duplicate check, including the silent ones nobody saw. The two user-judgement fields are the point: they are real decisions on real pairs, captured for free, and they are the only training labels free of Cat No leakage.

fields.description: As typed. Used only as a Step 0 exact-match key, never as a scoring clue.
fields.label: Cat No

fields.description: Set when an existing Item was being edited rather than a new one created. That item is excluded from its own results.
fields.label: Item Being Edited

fields.description: Checks on non-stock items are skipped before any scoring, so a logged row is always a stock item. Kept as a column so that assumption is visible rather than implied.
fields.label: Maintain Stock

fields.description: Logged for the reviewer, never scored.
fields.label: Typed Description (display only)

fields.description: Unchecked for every check made during the silent run. Users only judge pairs they were shown, so this column is what keeps that bias visible when the log is analysed later.
fields.label: Shown To User

fields.description: End to end, server side. Budget is 300 ms.
fields.label: Elapsed (ms)

fields.description: How many existing items the rare-word index shortlisted. Equal to the whole catalogue when the name had fewer than two usable words and the search fell back to a full scan.
fields.label: Candidates Considered

fields.description: The top 5, including the ones below the threshold that the user never saw.
fields.label: Matches

fields.options: Pairs that scored well enough to be offered and were then cancelled by the veto gate - a different size, grade, spec code or negation. These are the most useful rows in this table: if a rule is wrong, it shows up here first, with the reason that killed it.

fields.description: Filled in from the form panel. This is a human judgement on a real pair - the thing that makes this table worth building on day one.
fields.label: User Action
fields.options:
used existing
created anyway
gave up

fields.description: Asked for only when a strong warning was ignored. Four answers cover the real cases; anything else means the rules need a look.
fields.label: Override Reason
fields.options:
different size
different grade
genuinely new
service line

name: Item Match Log
